Striking the Bobroffs

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Ronald Bobroff the RAF attorney is on the ropes. We go back to our story and reveal how an old lady's refusal to give up has seen him fighting a losing battle for his professional integrity

Summary:
For years Ronald Bobroff and Partners have been taking advantage of RAF cases, in effect stealing from their clients claims. This week the tables turned as a posse of top advocates fought a legal battle to have his practice struck from the role

Further information:
STRIKING THE BOBROFFS PROPOSAL

On the 14th March Court 6A of the Pretoria High Court heard arguments from two of SA’s most well known and expensive advocates. Wim Trengrove appearing for the Law Society of the Northern Province and David Unterhalter for Discovery Health. Both arguments were about to seal the professional fate of Ronald Bobroff his son Darren, and Steven Bezuidenhout- all directors of RBP, Ronald Bobroff and Partners.

In March 2015 Carte Blanche exposed how this firm of attorneys had been knowingly charging their clients an illegal fee agreement for years – inflating their bills and leaving their already vulnerable clients with very little left over from their RAF claim.

Carte Blanche’s television expose followed on the back of over 30 articles written by Tony Beamish for Moneyweb. In our expose Mr Bobroff challenged Carte Blanche and insisted that he was the victim of a plot by Discovery Health to destroy his practice. That claim has never been taken seriously by the courts.

But the claim emerged from a legal fight between one of Discovery’s clients, the Grahams who were taken for a ride by Bobroff and his partners. Their matter backed by the power of the Medical scheme has been dragging on for years. But this week it finally came to a head. Discovery and the Grahams have told the courts that this case has severe risk for the public if Bobroff is allowed to continue to practice and as such, they have asked the courts to strike Ronald Bobroff and his directors off the roll.

The Bobroffs argue that they want a disciplinary process to unfold by the LSNP and that they will take their cue from them. The Law Society who dragged its heels on this matter for years has now agreed, after doing an investigation that the Bobroff’s should at the very least be suspended. Then in another twist in this long and sorry saga, the Bobroff’s sold their practice to avoid a curator taking over the business and a further investigation. This infuriated judge Ishmael

The story is awash with skullduggery and the Law Society itself has listed numerous infractions by this practice. Apart from over reaching, there is evidence of falsifying signatures, vat and tax fraud, money meant for clients being stashed away in private accounts, lack of record keeping and where evidence appears to point to the Bobroff’s wrong doing, they have destroyed records.


Carte Blanche goes back to this story and tracks the demise of the once mighty Ronald Bobroff.

Press Release:


Striking the Bobroffs
Personal injury lawyer Ronald Bobroff-once president of the law society - is now a fugitive from justice, living in Australia with his son Darren. Formerly directors of Ronald Bobroff and Partners, a court has now suspended them, pending a disciplinary enquiry. But will the Bobroffs ever return home to face the justice system they used to line their pockets, while their clients were exploited? Carte Blanche tracks their fall from grace.


Script:


BOBROFF’S JUDGEMENT DAY FINAL SCRIPT Friday 6th May

Commentary One
A year ago I confronted personal injury lawyer Ronald Bobroff in his offices.

Devi CB 2015
Would you say you run a respectable and ethical business?
RB
I believe so, I have been elected to the council of the law society and served as a president of the LS and held numerous offices within the law profession

Commentary Two music find
Ronald and his son Darren have had a spectacular fall from grace and are now fugitives, hiding out in Australia just outside Sidney in Vaucluse, minutes from the beach.

But until recently they were both directors of Ronald Bobroff and Partners. They have spent at least the last ten years milking the Road Accident Fund which paid their firm over a billion rands during that time

Ronald Bobroff CB 2015
We have never had a finding against us of unprofessional conduct. EVER!

Commentary Three music same
Ronald has always protested that he is innocent, but his clients, many seriously injured in road accidents were ripped off by his practice, and bore the brunt of what the legal profession calls, over reaching.

Devi
Is over reaching stealing
George
Yes, its theft by stealth, its taking money and disguising it as a fee when its not.

Commentary four
Attorney George Van Niekerk began a protracted battle with Bobroff, on behalf of his clients the Grahams, and their medical aid Discovery Health.

George
The Grahams have been saying from the start that there was something wrong in this practice. It took us five years and a huge amount of money to get to the point where the Bobroff’s realized the game was up

Commentary Five music
Bobroff had also underestimated his adversaries. His former cost consultant Cora Van Der Merwe, once fiercely loyal, saw his fraud first hand, and turned whistleblower

Up Sound Cora
they gave us all training on how to amend any document and you can print it out as if it is the original thing.




Commentary Six music
She leaked information to journalist Tony Beamish under the protected disclosures act. But it took its toll.

Cora
Getting out of this was like getting out of an abusive relationship

Commentary Seven
Cora has laid charges of kidnapping against Bobroff and a well known private investigator. They hacked her phone and accused her of theft of documents. Things got ridiculous when Ronald called her a Russian spy.

Devi?
She is a secret agent
Bobroff
That is what she tells me yes?

Commentary Eight
Rondald’s son Darren is a bit rough around the edges and he was clearly unhappy with her appearance on Carte Blanche.

Up sound Darren phone call
You ***dirty Dutchman whore ..jou vok!

Commentary Nine music
He has also insulted legal journalist Tony Beamish who has spent the last five years writing about Bobroff. Inevitably Tony’s path would cross with Attorney Anthony Millars, who has fought and won a number of cases against Bobroff and is now the new president of the Law Society

Anthony CB 2015
I think it’s the biggest legal fraud in SA history – R270 million and that is just what we know

Commentary ten music
But Bobroff dug in, insisting his illegal fee agreement was valid. The high court, the Supreme court of appeal, and the Constitutional court all found against him. But even after that court’s findings he was unrepentant

Devi from CB 2015
Don’t you feel bad Ronald?!
Not at all I feel proud of what we have done!
That you took money from people and you were wrong about it and we know you were wrong
Ronald
I disagree with you I think it was great service to the public




Commentary eleven
By 2015 Bobroff was beginning to bleed, paying back millions to his former clients who took him to court, and won back the money he should have paid them in the first place. Some of his accident victims will never get their outstanding money

Devi CB 2015
And are you not going to go back and find those cases
Ronald
Definitely not
Devi
And you don’t feel you should from a moral point of view
Ronald
I can’t begin to understand why you would say that?
Devi
I can’t begin to understand why you insist that you wont!
Ronald
Well that is where we differ

Up sound Smash

Commentary twelve
When Matthew Graham had his devastating brain injury, he had no idea he was being swindled by Bobroff. But when attorney George Van Niekerk reviewed his case, he soon discovered Bobroff’s fraud.

The Law society is the guardian of the legal profession, but they did nothing at the time, forcing Van Niekerk to take THEM to court, where they were ordered to investigate the Bobroff’s

Devi Link
For two years Bobroff refused to allow the law society inspectors in to do a full investigation, even though it had been ordered by a court- eventually last year Bobroff capitulated – some records had been destroyed but it was that investigation that has laid the foundation for the law society to say enough is enough!

Commentary thirteen
The report finally released in January describes unprofessional, dishonorable conduct and over reaching. Their contraventions include forgery, vat and income tax evasion, concealing accounts, and failing to pay clients within a reasonable time amongst other infractions.

Anthony Millar
And the final conclusion, which is really the most damning conclusion is that the trust account lost its identity. In other words the Bobroffs were treating the trust account as if it was their own

Devi
Isn’t that a cardinal sin in your profession?
Anthony
It’s the ultimate sin …its other people’s money Devi, its other people’s money.

Commentary fourteen
One of those other people was Sandra Chetty. Her husband Mark went into a coma after his accident. He spent 6 weeks on life support and then began his new life as a quadriplegic.

Sandra
I would go to work, he would cry and say imagine I was the breadwinner and now you have to work because he couldn’t even hold a screwdriver

Commentary fifteen
In 2010, approached by Darren Bobroff, they signed their illegal fee agreement.

Sandra
The way they treated my husband it was like he was a stupid man living in the street

Commentary Sixteen
Bobroff settled with the RAF without telling them, they were given the settlement on a scrap of paper, and then they waited three years for the money.

Devi
So you finally get the money and then the cheques bounced?

Sandra
It was such a disappointment! I looked at my husband and said you know I think these people are robbing us

Commentary seventeen
What Sandy didn’t know then, was she was right, because Bobroff had overcharged them by R1.2 million rand

LINK
Then in 2014 Mark Chetty passed away, even three days before his death he made it very clear that he was deeply unhappy with the way in which the Bobroffs had treated his family

Commentary eighteen
It was only after the Chetty’s saw the Carte Blanche story that they took Ronald to court and were able to recover the money. Six years later

Sandra
If it wasn’t for Carte blanche, I wouldn’t have known nothing, Bobroff would have had his party

Devi link
For Bobroff the Grahams were probably just another client – but its largely due to the Grahams that Bobroff is finally facing the music- backed by the muscle of their medical aid, Discovery health, they decided that in the public interest it was time to bring Ronald and his son Darren to book

Commentary nineteen music
Bobroff still owes Mathew Graham half a million rands

George
They are reluctant poster kids for the Bobroffs greed, they have been abused, they have been threatened by the Bobroffs, the Bobroffs have tried to buy them off.
Devi
Which the Grahams turned down
George
Yes because they realized there was more at stake and they were insisting that the Bobroffs couldn’t escape the censure of the Law Society, by buying their silence effectively

COURT UP SOUND: ALL RISE

Commentary twenty
And so on the 14th March the Grahams, backed by Discovery moved to have the Bobroff’s struck from the roll of attorneys. Ronald and Darren were noticeably absent. Advocate David Unterhalter acted for the Grahams.

David Unterhalter
There is a certain point at which courts have to say you have run your course with us, you have twisted the processes of law, you have abused them, you have been found in contempt of them. You have simply failed to do your duty as an attorney and officer of the court. You cannot ask the court now to delay what is inevitable not least when you don’t even begin to sketch what it is that you can say.

Commentary twenty- two
The Law society had at last agreed that the Bobroff’s should be struck from the roll- but disagreed with the Graham’s on procedure. Advocate Wim Trengove argued their case

Wim Trengove
The difference between us is simply this: They suggest that, because the case against the Bobroffs is serious, they should be shot at dawn, as it were, without any further hearing. The Law Society submits that it would be unlawful to resort to that summary execution. Even take people with strong cases against them under our law, are entitled to a fair hearing
Commentary twenty- three
Watching from the back was Cora Van Der Merwe who finally felt vindicated

Cora Van Der Merwe
It was liberating everyone protected the bobroffs and when I listened to the arguments even from the Law Society, I realized I can have faith in the justice system again.

Commentary twenty-four
Cora now runs a successful cost consulting company, determining legal bills. And Bobroff, she discovered was up to his old tricks, long after our programme aired

Devi
How much did they charge to read clients e mails, one clients e mails?
Cora
R225 000 – one specific item R51 000 rand
Devi
On one day?
Ya
To read e mails from the client?
Ya!

Link
Then just days before the court convened, the Bobroff’s abruptly sold the practice

Commentary twenty- five
Advocate Cassim acting for the Bobroff’s, did his best to justify the decision

Advocate Nazeer Cassim
So my lord there is nothing improper with buying current files

Commentary twenty- six
But Judge Ismail was having none of it.

JUDGE ISMAIL: But can you imagine if this becomes the norm in legal practice. Every attorney who is under scrutiny from the Law Society can do this and the clients would not know who their attorneys any longer are.
MR CASSIM: But My Lord, absolutely... Your Lordship is correct. He must... He is at duty to disclose to the Law Society, because... ISMAIL J: To the client?!!
MR CASSIM: Because that is all he is worried about.
ISMAIL J: To the client?
MR CASSIM: To the client too, because your... [intervene].
ISMAIL J: The Law Society is simply there to be act as a guardian here... [intervene].
MR CASSIM: Ja.
ISMAIL J: But if the client does not know that, what is in essence happening? The client becomes a pawn on a chessboard...
Commentary Twenty- seven
Judgement was reserved, but then the Hawks finally moved in.

Devi link
The Hawks asked the Bobroffs to hand themselves over but Ronald and Darren had other plans



Commentary twenty-eight
So while the judges deliberated, Ronald and his son Darren arrived in Sidney, escaping the very justice system that they had abused.

Devi
Why did they run?
George
Bobroff has been telling us for five years he has an answer but I think he ran out of runway he could afford to keep us on a string, but he came to a point…. I think he ran out of giving simple answer to what were simple questions

Commentary Twenty- nine
We had our own simple question, and gave Bobroff a call
Devi
How are you
Bobroff
I am fine but I have nothing to say to you!
Devi
Did you skip the country Ronald!
Click!
Devi
Well, short and sharp!

Commentary thirty MUSIC
But back at Bobroff and Partners there was a problem. The RAF were about to pay R45 million into their trust account that belonged to clients, putting that money at serious risk. The court agreed to a curator to protect the funds

Anthony
Devi we have instructed attorneys in Australia and they have confirmed to us that Darren Bobroff has properties has 4 properties in Australia worth 4- 6 million Australian dollars – that is R46 million to R70 million of property.

Devi Link
The hawks then swooped on Ronald’s wife Elaine- she was charged with money laundering and fraud while Ronald and Darren stayed firmly put on Australian soil.

Commentary Thirty- one music
At her bail application, Elaine Bobroff told the judge she was not aware of R53 million rand going through her bank account and denied any involvement in unlawful activity. She is out on bail and must appear in court again in July

Up Sound All Rise – Judgement Day

On 26th April the judgement was delivered. Ronald and Darren were suspended

Up sound Judge Ranchod
The 3rd and 4th respondents are ordered to immediately to surrender and deliver to the registra of this court their certificates of enrolment as attorneys and conveyancers.

Commentary Thirty-Two music
The judge also reversed the sale of their business. Now only two picture hooks remain on the wall where their certificates once were. The Bobroff’s have squirreled away millions, the only real question now, is when will the NPA act?


THE END 14 min 11 seconds
In at 00 01 00 00
Out at 00 15 00 00
Promo one: in at 00 15 30 00
Promo two in at 00 16 00 00
Promo three in at 00 16 30 00


PROMO ONE
We track the demise of personal Injury Lawyer’s Ronald Bobroff and his son Darren
Now fugitives from justice, hiding from the Hawks


PROMO TWO

David Unterhalter
There is a certain point at which courts have to say you have run your course with us, you have twisted the processes of law, you have abused them

Commentary 15 seconds
The ongoing saga of the Bobroffs, who skipped the country weeks before a court suspends him and his son from practicing law


PROMO THREE 15 seconds
Ronald Bobroff protests his innocence, even as the Hawks arrest his wife, he’s hiding out in Australia, and he faces a massive case of fraud with his son Darren

Devi from CB 2015
Don’t you feel bad Ronald?!
Not at all I feel proud of what we have done!

Anthony It’s the ultimate sin …its other people’s money Devi, its other people’s money. Commentary fourteen One of those other people was Sandra Chetty. Her husband Mark went into a coma after his accident. He spent 6 weeks on life support and then began his new life as a quadriplegic. Sandra I would go to work, he would cry and say imagine I was the breadwinner and now you have to work because he couldn’t even hold a screwdriver Commentary fifteen In 2010, approached by Darren Bobroff, they signed their illegal fee agreement. Sandra The way they treated my husband it was like he was a stupid man living in the street Commentary Sixteen Bobroff settled with the RAF without telling them, they were given the settlement on a scrap of paper, and then they waited three years for the money. Devi So you finally get the money and then the cheques bounced? Sandra It was such a disappointment! I looked at my husband and said you know I think these people are robbing us Commentary seventeen What Sandy didn’t know then, was she was right, because Bobroff had overcharged them by R1.2 million rand LINK Then in 2014 Mark Chetty passed away, even three days before his death he made it very clear that he was deeply unhappy with the way in which the Bobroffs had treated his family Commentary eighteen It was only after the Chetty’s saw the Carte Blanche story that they took Ronald to court and were able to recover the money. Six years later Sandra If it wasn’t for Carte blanche, I wouldn’t have known nothing, Bobroff would have had his party Devi link For Bobroff the Grahams were probably just another client – but its largely due to the Grahams that Bobroff is finally facing the music- backed by the muscle of their medical aid, Discovery health, they decided that in the public interest it was time to bring Ronald and his son Darren to book Commentary nineteen music Bobroff still owes Mathew Graham half a million rands George They are reluctant poster kids for the Bobroffs greed, they have been abused, they have been threatened by the Bobroffs, the Bobroffs have tried to buy them off. Devi Which the Grahams turned down George Yes because they realized there was more at stake and they were insisting that the Bobroffs couldn’t escape the censure of the Law Society, by buying their silence effectively COURT UP SOUND: ALL RISE Commentary twenty And so on the 14th March the Grahams, backed by Discovery moved to have the Bobroff’s struck from the roll of attorneys. Ronald and Darren were noticeably absent. Advocate David Unterhalter acted for the Grahams. David Unterhalter There is a certain point at which courts have to say you have run your course with us, you have twisted the processes of law, you have abused them, you have been found in contempt of them. You have simply failed to do your duty as an attorney and officer of the court. You cannot ask the court now to delay what is inevitable not least when you don’t even begin to sketch what it is that you can say. Commentary twenty- two The Law society had at last agreed that the Bobroff’s should be struck from the roll- but disagreed with the Graham’s on procedure. Advocate Wim Trengove argued their case Wim Trengove The difference between us is simply this: They suggest that, because the case against the Bobroffs is serious, they should be shot at dawn, as it were, without any further hearing. The Law Society submits that it would be unlawful to resort to that summary execution. Even take people with strong cases against them under our law, are entitled to a fair hearing Commentary twenty- three Watching from the back was Cora Van Der Merwe who finally felt vindicated Cora Van Der Merwe It was liberating everyone protected the bobroffs and when I listened to the arguments even from the Law Society, I realized I can have faith in the justice system again. Commentary twenty-four Cora now runs a successful cost consulting company, determining legal bills. And Bobroff, she discovered was up to his old tricks, long after our programme aired Devi How much did they charge to read clients e mails, one clients e mails? Cora R225 000 – one specific item R51 000 rand Devi On one day? Ya To read e mails from the client? Ya! Link Then just days before the court convened, the Bobroff’s abruptly sold the practice Commentary twenty- five Advocate Cassim acting for the Bobroff’s, did his best to justify the decision Advocate Nazeer Cassim So my lord there is nothing improper with buying current files Commentary twenty- six But Judge Ismail was having none of it. JUDGE ISMAIL: But can you imagine if this becomes the norm in legal practice. Every attorney who is under scrutiny from the Law Society can do this and the clients would not know who their attorneys any longer are. MR CASSIM: But My Lord, absolutely... Your Lordship is correct. He must... He is at duty to disclose to the Law Society, because... ISMAIL J: To the client?!! MR CASSIM: Because that is all he is worried about. ISMAIL J: To the client? MR CASSIM: To the client too, because your... [intervene]. ISMAIL J: The Law Society is simply there to be act as a guardian here... [intervene]. MR CASSIM: Ja. ISMAIL J: But if the client does not know that, what is in essence happening? The client becomes a pawn on a chessboard... Commentary Twenty- seven Judgement was reserved, but then the Hawks finally moved in. Devi link The Hawks asked the Bobroffs to hand themselves over but Ronald and Darren had other plans Commentary twenty-eight So while the judges deliberated, Ronald and his son Darren arrived in Sidney, escaping the very justice system that they had abused. Devi Why did they run? George Bobroff has been telling us for five years he has an answer but I think he ran out of runway he could afford to keep us on a string, but he came to a point…. I think he ran out of giving simple answer to what were simple questions Commentary Twenty- nine We had our own simple question, and gave Bobroff a call Devi How are you Bobroff I am fine but I have nothing to say to you! Devi Did you skip the country Ronald! Click! Devi Well, short and sharp! Commentary thirty MUSIC But back at Bobroff and Partners there was a problem. The RAF were about to pay R45 million into their trust account that belonged to clients, putting that money at serious risk. The court agreed to a curator to protect the funds Anthony Devi we have instructed attorneys in Australia and they have confirmed to us that Darren Bobroff has properties has 4 properties in Australia worth 4- 6 million Australian dollars – that is R46 million to R70 million of property. Devi Link The hawks then swooped on Ronald’s wife Elaine- she was charged with money laundering and fraud while Ronald and Darren stayed firmly put on Australian soil. Commentary Thirty- one music At her bail application, Elaine Bobroff told the judge she was not aware of R53 million rand going through her bank account and denied any involvement in unlawful activity. She is out on bail and must appear in court again in July Up Sound All Rise – Judgement Day On 26th April the judgement was delivered. Ronald and Darren were suspended Up sound Judge Ranchod The 3rd and 4th respondents are ordered to immediately to surrender and deliver to the registra of this court their certificates of enrolment as attorneys and conveyancers. Commentary Thirty-Two music The judge also reversed the sale of their business. Now only two picture hooks remain on the wall where their certificates once were. The Bobroff’s have squirreled away millions, the only real question now, is when will the NPA act? THE END 14 min 11 seconds In at 00 01 00 00 Out at 00 15 00 00 Promo one: in at 00 15 30 00 Promo two in at 00 16 00 00 Promo three in at 00 16 30 00 PROMO ONE We track the demise of personal Injury Lawyer’s Ronald Bobroff and his son Darren Now fugitives from justice, hiding from the Hawks PROMO TWO David Unterhalter There is a certain point at which courts have to say you have run your course with us, you have twisted the processes of law, you have abused them Commentary 15 seconds The ongoing saga of the Bobroffs, who skipped the country weeks before a court suspends him and his son from practicing law PROMO THREE 15 seconds Ronald Bobroff protests his innocence, even as the Hawks arrest his wife, he’s hiding out in Australia, and he faces a massive case of fraud with his son Darren Devi from CB 2015 Don’t you feel bad Ronald?! metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Ronald Bobroff the RAF attorney is on the ropes. We go back to our story and reveal how an old lady's refusal to give up has seen him fighting a losing battle for his professional integrity
metadata.Summary: For years Ronald Bobroff and Partners have been taking advantage of RAF cases, in effect stealing from their clients claims. This week the tables turned as a posse of top advocates fought a legal battle to have his practice struck from the role
metadata.Further information: STRIKING THE BOBROFFS PROPOSAL On the 14th March Court 6A of the Pretoria High Court heard arguments from two of SA’s most well known and expensive advocates. Wim Trengrove appearing for the Law Society of the Northern Province and David Unterhalter for Discovery Health. Both arguments were about to seal the professional fate of Ronald Bobroff his son Darren, and Steven Bezuidenhout- all directors of RBP, Ronald Bobroff and Partners. In March 2015 Carte Blanche exposed how this firm of attorneys had been knowingly charging their clients an illegal fee agreement for years – inflating their bills and leaving their already vulnerable clients with very little left over from their RAF claim. Carte Blanche’s television expose followed on the back of over 30 articles written by Tony Beamish for Moneyweb. In our expose Mr Bobroff challenged Carte Blanche and insisted that he was the victim of a plot by Discovery Health to destroy his practice. That claim has never been taken seriously by the courts. But the claim emerged from a legal fight between one of Discovery’s clients, the Grahams who were taken for a ride by Bobroff and his partners. Their matter backed by the power of the Medical scheme has been dragging on for years. But this week it finally came to a head. Discovery and the Grahams have told the courts that this case has severe risk for the public if Bobroff is allowed to continue to practice and as such, they have asked the courts to strike Ronald Bobroff and his directors off the roll. The Bobroffs argue that they want a disciplinary process to unfold by the LSNP and that they will take their cue from them. The Law Society who dragged its heels on this matter for years has now agreed, after doing an investigation that the Bobroff’s should at the very least be suspended. Then in another twist in this long and sorry saga, the Bobroff’s sold their practice to avoid a curator taking over the business and a further investigation. This infuriated judge Ishmael The story is awash with skullduggery and the Law Society itself has listed numerous infractions by this practice. Apart from over reaching, there is evidence of falsifying signatures, vat and tax fraud, money meant for clients being stashed away in private accounts, lack of record keeping and where evidence appears to point to the Bobroff’s wrong doing, they have destroyed records. Carte Blanche goes back to this story and tracks the demise of the once mighty Ronald Bobroff.
